author: voiders
quote: The game is incredibly good and at the same time incredibly bad. During the first 4 to 5 hours I was thinking it was one of the best games I've ever played. Then I realized it was one of the worst and I couldn't stand it until the end.Positive points:- Graphics, environments and the initial criminal and ritualistic plot.Negative points:- Puzzles everywhere all the time. There are puzzles about lamps, post-its, crime scenes, codes, padlocks, passwords... My God, I couldn't stand it anymore, every 2 steps is a puzzle. People don't understand that there is no such thing as "the more the merrier".- Tiring, absurdly bad and meaningless story. Later I'll break it down into spoilers to prove that the ending and the entire context make no sense.- Loops everywhere.- A completely idiotic musical.- Most of it is based on real movies.- The game gets tiring and you can't stand it anymore. I finished it with a vengeance.About the terrible story:1- It makes absolutely no sense for a creature or being, interdimensional, spiritual, evil or whatever, to "feed off the art of artists". Seriously? It makes it seem like an artist is a superior being to other people. The plot would have been better if it had said that Alan Wake went crazy, that he became bipolar and created his own alter ego and somehow has paranormal powers. It would have made much more sense.2- Much of the story is completely forced, for example, the sect, where at the beginning they do everything they can to look like villains, and you even fight against possessed people who seem to be from the sect, but in the end they were normal, good people fighting against possessed people. Please.3- Everything that Alan Wake keeps changing all the time is pretty pathetic. If what he writes becomes true, he should just write the happy ending. "Oh, but it has to match the plot and the book". It's all screwed up and nothing matches anything.

author: voiders
quote:
This game has totally false media and users reviews.
I'm one of the most fan from old game. And I defended the remake for a long time. I did pre-order it on the first hour. Defended the changes from original when people start complaining about graphics problems, different battle system... script changes...

But then I realize. Square is ruining everything like Disney do with everything they touch.

It's a commum problem on now days. Every movie, series and other pieces of art and entertainment suffers from same problem.

The authors never get satisfied just to bring the best of their vision. They need constatly surprise the users. All the time, each moment changing everything to bring something people didn't expected.

This plot twist addiction corrodes everything. Now Aerith dead is not enough. You need a 2 hours battle in the middle of the scene, with more and more and more. And you can´t even understand the most import, how she died?

Can you get how stupid it is? Now you have ghosts, and ghosts fighting other ghost from other color, multiverse, dead alive... Dead who die from what? Sepheroth even touch she, and then she still die. Why? Cancer in the middle of the pray?

It´s absurd. It´s like disney with the star wars new trilogy. The same nom sense problems.

FFVII from my age didn't try surprise the users. It´s get all the plote naturally. All the fiction was the FFVII script. You can see the author did what he saw. Now they are writing what they think they need to do to suprise and sell. That is why it´s horrible like  most of adaptations, remasters, remakes...

I´m so sad to say it. But this game fail hard. Look to the twitch numbers. Rebirth has lower viewers and channels on the release day than FFXVI and the Remake. They lost the chance to bring something epic and bigger than ever. How can FFVII Rebirth is smaller than FFXVI from last year? They did it. Congratilations! 

But here is not a place to blurt out, right? Lets list this game problem:
- Horrible script change, stupid multiverse BS fiction
- Same absurd lazy problem to add characters that is not playable (Red XIII / Remake, Vincent and Cid / Rebirth). Absurd strategy to do that.
- Game still complete linear like remake. No "open world". Real open world is totally different. It´s like Zelda or GTA. Not this chapter game.
- Worst ending ever. They forget to add godzilla on the middle of Aerith death? Maybe the release a DLC to add power ranger and mickey mouse to the ending.
- Bad graphics. Looks like 1080p with low resolution textures, worst ilumination, DOF, agressive motion blur, agressive dynamic resolution, a little of chromatic aberration... Remake has absolute better graphics. Some times Rebirth looks like a PS3 game. And it´s not like 1 or 2 times, it´s very common. Just the cut-scenes are good.
- They bring NPCs direct from the worst of Mass Effect Andromeda

From remake to rebirth numbers are just getting lower. Now I´m who don´t even care about the 3rd part.

Square is on the rock bottom. People and media is trying hard to save it.
I did the same so many times too. But now I have to be free from this. It´s horrible and I don´t care to save it anymore.

Good luck to will keep defending this company. I recommend playing it on a portable 2k monitor like I did. It´s the perfect to PS5. It´s minimaze a lot of the lack of good harware. It can´t handle a grate image to a big 4k tv.

author: voiders
quote:
English:
I have this game for ps4. Im a huge fano f mk, the game is good, but have some problems. Lets talk about the points:

The good ones:
- Nice new characters.
- Good history.
- The faction wars.

The bad ones:
- Less characters and scenarios then MK (2011). WTF!?
- They remove the 4 players mode. WHY?
- So short the campaign mode.
- Characters of campaign thay you defeat but you cant play with it.
- A very strange coloring/saturation/contrast in the game. Like killer instinct at xbox one, that spoil the graphics!

For that reasons I bealive that MKX is worse than the last one (MK 2011). The MK 2011 bring back the game. So I think MKX should only add new features and characters, not remove then.
=======================================================================
Português:
Tenho este jogo na versão do ps4. Sou um grande fã da marca, achei o jogo bom, mas tem grandes defeitos. Separando os pontos que acredito serem relevantes:

Positivos:
- Os novos personagens tem profundidade, são ótimos.
- Boa história.
- As facções foram uma ideia legal.

Negativos:
- Tem poucos personagens e cenários. Menos que o antecessor. O que é um absurdo.
- Não permite mais jogar com 4 pessoas! Não da pra acreditar que fizeram isso.
- Campanha da história curta.
- Personagens que aparecem pra lutar na história mas que não são jogáveis.
- Gráficos com saturação de cor ou contraste fora do comum, que estragam os gráficos. Parece o killer instinct do xbox one.

Por estas rações, acho que o MKX esta um pouco pior que o antecessor. Do meu ponto de vista, o jogo lançado em 2011 trouxe a franquia de volta aos bons tempos, e este agora deveria ter acrescido a ele em número, sem tirar nada que tinha de bom. Da forma que foi feito parece que foi um trabalho realizado sem capricho.

quote:
I know, is a fun game. But I have to write about Titanfall problems.
1- Is just a Call of Duty clone. Every moviment, gameplay, shoting, weapons is at least similar to CoD.
2- Is a 6x6 multiplayer with the "dumbest" bots of all time. Why? I told you. Because Titanfall wants you and everyone killing more than dying. Every noob will think he is good. The titan it self help on this way too.
3- Titanfall is a combination of a Call of Duty Productor + EA Games + Microsoft Plataform. Could it be worse?
4- Like Call of Duty, Titanfall was made to make noobs happy. On both games is very easy to kill. Just hold the trigger and the weapon will do the magic for you. You can be far away from the target, but all the shots will go perfectly straight to it. The weapon dont have recoil, is so artificial. All this things make the game more easy for the noobs.Even Counter Strike 1.5 has more realistic weapons than CoD and Titanfall.
5- Concluding: Im not saying that you cant have fun with this game. You probably will. But dont change the fact that Im talking about. That game **** like CoD, but will sell like water. Unfortunately.
